name: test
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.1'
      - run: bundle install
      - run: bundle exec rake test

GEM
  remote: https://rubygems.org/
  specs:
    minitest (5.15.0)
    rake (13.0.6)
    rake-compiler (1.2.5)
      rake

PLATFORMS
  x86_64-linux

DEPENDENCIES
  minitest (= 5.15.0)
  rake (= 13.0.6)

BUNDLED WITH
   2.3.27

require "rake/extensiontask"
require "rake/testtask"

Rake::ExtensionTask.new("fastcsv")

Rake::TestTask.new(:test) do |t|
  t.libs << "test"
end

task test: :compile

require 'minitest/autorun'
require_relative '../lib/fastcsv'

class FastcsvTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_parses_line
    assert_equal 'a,b', FastCSV.parse_line('a,b')
  end
end
